Subject: Request: Personnel training/background evidence for SOC 2/SIG review

Hi Jonas —

We're kicking off the personnel controls portion of Fintegrity's SIG/SOC 2 review and need a compact bundle of evidence related to employee security training, background checks, and onboarding/offboarding controls for Redwood personnel who have access to customer data. Specifically we'd like:

- A training completion roster (course ids, completion dates, and org unit) for the last 36 months
- Evidence of background checks or attestations for hires in the past 24 months (redacted PII is fine)
- Onboarding and deprovisioning logs showing access provisioning and removal events (last 24 months)
- Your redaction approach and a short chain-of-custody note for artifacts you provide

If possible please provide an initial bundle by 2026-12-03 so our reviewers can ingest and flag any follow-up questions. Delivery as encrypted ZIP or a shared Drive folder with view-only links is fine (preferred: Drive link).

If there are any known gaps (e.g., legacy hires without digitized records) please note them in your response so we can scope sampling.

Thanks — looking forward to working together.

— AuditsByProxy team
